provenance.source_note: pm/roadmap/task-board/README.md declares the slug, TB prefix, and project title.

source_intent.idea: Extend the existing support queue so an agent can suggest assignments while a person keeps control of the final owner.

provenance.source_note: The user asked to add assignment suggestions without automatic assignment.

phases.title: Shared queue
phases.goal: Make the local queue safe for a small support team.

stories.title: Suggest a ticket owner
stories.problem: Support leads currently scan every open ticket and team member by hand before choosing an owner.

scope_in.text: Rank eligible team members for one open ticket using skills and current open-ticket count.

provenance.source_note: The user named skills and current workload as the two inputs for a useful suggestion.

scope_in.text: Show the facts behind each suggestion before the support lead chooses an owner.

provenance.source_note: Recommended to match the user's review-first autonomy level and keep the suggestion inspectable.

scope_out.text: Changing a ticket owner without a support lead's explicit action.

provenance.source_note: The user explicitly prohibited autonomous assignment.

scope_out.text: Replacing the existing command-line interface with a web application.

provenance.source_note: README.md identifies the maintained product as a Python 3.9 command-line application.

acceptance_criteria.text: For a fixed ticket and team fixture, the command returns the same ranked candidates and explains each score from skills and workload.

provenance.source_note: Recommended as deterministic proof of the ranking and explanation behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: Running the suggestion command leaves the ticket's saved owner unchanged.

provenance.source_note: The user requires a person to make every final ownership change.

acceptance_criteria.text: /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passes on Python 3.9.

provenance.source_note: pyproject.toml records Python 3.9 as the floor and the fixture repository's unit-test command.
The current phase status names TB-2-03 as the next story slot in the existing roadmap.

exit_criteria.text: A support lead can request a ranked, explained suggestion for a fixture ticket, choose an owner separately, and pass the existing Python 3.9 test suite.

provenance.source_note: Recommended as the first usable maintain-mode milestone combining the user's outcome with repository verification facts.
Recommended as non-secret local metadata for a review-oriented agent profile; no runtime authority is included.

unresolved_questions.question: When two candidates have equal skills and workload, should the ranking prefer the longest-idle person or leave them tied?

provenance.source_note: The user said either tie behavior could work and deferred the decision.
